Pre-flight grep proved both wrong: `@@schema("public")` on EcommerceOrder + Customer + EcommerceOrderItem AND no tenantId column anywhere. Orders were GLOBAL — shared across all tenants. The 21b admin-xendit-config.delete FK count was actually counting orders across every tenant. This invalidated the .whatsnext's webhook resolution strategy (search_path iteration). Scope grew from ~18K to ~25K (added schema + migration) but stayed Tier 2.
  - SCHEMA MIGRATION STRATEGY — three-stage backfill (ADD nullable → UPDATE → SET NOT NULL → FK → INDEX) handles empty DB (vacuous success), populated DB with tenants (backfill to oldest tenant by created_at), and missing-tenants edge case (NOT NULL step fails loudly — caller must seed tenant first). Used "tenants" + "ecommerce_orders" bare table names matching init migration style (no public schema qualifier).
  - WEBHOOK SECURITY ORDERING DECISION — early-exit on missing x-callback-token header (cheap, no DB hit, no enumeration risk) BEFORE parse JSON, then find order, then resolve config, then timingSafeEqual. Returns 401 (NOT 200) on unknown order — explicit enumeration-prevention departure from prior behavior. Trade-off: Xendit would retry indefinitely if hit with a bogus order ID, but Xendit only sends webhooks for invoices it created on YOUR tenant's behalf, so this is theoretical. Banked as a design decision lesson.
  - LATENT BUG FIX (FREE) — admin-xendit-config.delete() FK count was scanning EcommerceOrder.xenditPaymentId across ALL tenants pre-21c. Now scoped by ctx.tenantId. Surfaced during the schema review, fixed inline. Corrected the 21b lesson banked at lessons.md.
  - testConnection STAYS DIRECT — admin-xendit-config.testConnection still instantiates Xendit SDK directly (NOT via getXenditClient(tenantId)) because getXenditClient now throws if !isVerified, but testConnection is exactly the procedure that FLIPS isVerified true. Chicken-and-egg. The direct instantiation is the intentional exception, documented inline.
  - DEPLOYMENT GATES — TWO open flags before staging/prod deploy: (1) [CARRIED from 21a] APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY must be in .env.staging + .env.prod — without it, every Xendit checkout AND every webhook throws at decrypt-time.
